import { Pagination, Card } from "march/ui" import { arrowLeft, arrowRight } from "march/icons" // Pagination'ın bütün özellikleri: page (bind:page = page + setPage), pages, onPage, siblings, variant, total, size, // sizes, onSize, hasPrev, hasNext, onPrev, onNext, info, status, label, labels (previous, next, page, sizes), // controls, prev, next, gap, class, m:color const Row = (props: { title: string; children?: unknown }) =>
{props.title} {props.children}
export function PaginationLab() { let $page = 1 let $last = "—" let $mini = 3 let $rowsPage = 2 let $size = 20 let $batch = 1 return
$last = String(p)} prev="‹ Geri" next="İleri ›" gap="·" label="Sonuç sayfaları" labels={{ previous: "Önceki sayfa", next: "Sonraki sayfa", page: (n: number) => `Sayfa ${n}` }} m:color="brand-blue" class="lab-numbers" /> {"Son seçilen: " + $last} { $size = n; $rowsPage = 1 }} info={(r: { from: number; to: number; total: number }) => `${r.from}–${r.to} / ${r.total} satır`} status={(p: number, n: number) => `Sayfa ${p} / ${n}`} labels={{ previous: "Önceki", next: "Sonraki", sizes: "Satır sayısı" }} class="lab-simple" /> 1} hasNext={$batch < 4} onPrev={() => $batch--} onNext={() => $batch++} prev={arrowLeft} next={arrowRight} labels={{ previous: "Daha yeni", next: "Daha eski" }} class="lab-cursor" /> {"Yığın " + $batch}
}
